verdict.rationale: Secureframe's docs say it automates the SOC 2 process at every step to audit readiness, condensing 200+ controls into 8 key steps. Each framework includes control mapping and automated testing that collects evidence from integrated tools, and auditor-approved policy templates come with an editor, so the core of an in-platform SOC 2 program is clearly documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Type I vs Type II support, Trust Services Criteria named as the control set, auditor evidence-request workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
